project.description: Uploads a bdc.env for one stack and a configuration.json shared by both. bdc.env goes to configs/pic-sure-frontend/<target_stack>/bdc.env, so the two stacks can hold different values; it carries LOGGING_API_KEY, which must match the same stack's rendered logging.env or pic-sure-logging answers the frontend's audit events with 401 and they are dropped. configuration.json is not stack-scoped and lands in configs/pic-sure-frontend/ for every stack. Neither file takes effect until the frontend is rebuilt and redeployed for that stack.

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: TARGET_STACK
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: Which stack's bdc.env to act on. Based on selection we determine if is a or b stack. configuration.json is shared by both stacks and is not affected by this choice.

hudson.model.FileParameterDefinition.name: bdc.env
hudson.model.FileParameterDefinition.description: Upload a bdc.env file that has been configured and will be used to configure the PIC-SURE-Frontend app

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash
set -e # Source folder containing the scripts source_scripts_folder="${JENKINS_HOME}/workspace/Bash_Functions/" ls -la "$source_scripts_folder"
# Iterate through the files in the folder and source them for script_file in "$source_scripts_folder"*.sh; do chmod +x "$script_file" if [ -f "$script_file" ] && [ -x "$script_file" ]; then echo "sourcing $script_file" source "$script_file" fi done
: "${TARGET_STACK:?TARGET_STACK is required}" target_stack=$(get_stack "$TARGET_STACK") echo "Resolved TARGET_STACK ${TARGET_STACK} to stack ${target_stack}"
# Check if bdc.env exists and is not empty BDC_ENV="bdc.env" CONFIG_JSON="configuration.json"
# Check if bdc.env exists and is not empty if [[ -f "$BDC_ENV" && -s "$BDC_ENV" ]]; then echo "Uploading $BDC_ENV to S3..." aws s3 --sse=AES256 cp "$BDC_ENV" "s3://$stack_s3_bucket/configs/pic-sure-frontend/$target_stack/$BDC_ENV" else echo "Warning: $BDC_ENV is either empty or does not exist. Skipping upload." fi
# Check if configuration.json exists and is not empty if [[ -f "$CONFIG_JSON" && -s "$CONFIG_JSON" ]]; then echo "Uploading $CONFIG_JSON to S3..." aws s3 --sse=AES256 cp "$CONFIG_JSON" "s3://$stack_s3_bucket/configs/pic-sure-frontend/$CONFIG_JSON" else echo "Warning: $CONFIG_JSON is either empty or does not exist. Skipping upload." fi
